title: Streaming Chat Thread
description: Research-assistant thread with attachments, collapsible reasoning, code blocks, message actions, a branch picker, scroll-to-latest and a send/stop composer.

title: Agent App Shell
description: Full-screen copilot app with a thread-list sidebar, model palette, empty-state suggestions and generative-UI tool results rendered as cards.

title: Floating Support Copilot
description: Embeddable support assistant: launcher bubble, cited answers, quick actions, human handoff and a feedback bar over a docs page.

title: Agent Prompt Composer
description: Composer variants with attachment tiles, @-mentions and slash commands, a searchable model palette, context-usage ring, dictation and submit states.

title: Reasoning & Chain of Thought
description: Reasoning that opens while thinking and settles to “Thought for 6 seconds”, a chain-of-thought with search steps, and an agent run log with a thinking bar.

title: Tool Call Lifecycle
description: One tool in every state from pending to denied, plus a live run with grouped tools, inline approval and a generative-UI result card.

title: Sources & Inline Citations
description: Answer-engine result with source cards, inline citation pills that open a hover carousel, a sources disclosure and streamed follow-ups.

title: Agent Loading States
description: Specimen sheet of loaders for agent UIs: spinners, dots, wave, terminal cursor, text shimmer, thinking bar and skeleton messages in three sizes.

title: Approvals & Questions
description: Human-in-the-loop patterns: tool confirmations with outcomes, elicitation and option-list questions, checkpoints, system messages and feedback.

title: Plan, Queue & Tasks
description: Coding-agent plan card that builds step by step, a queue of messages and todos, and task disclosures with file chips and diff stats.

title: Chat + Artifact Workspace
description: IDE-style split view: agent chat on the left, an artifact panel with web preview, code and file tree, streaming terminal and test results.

title: Agent Run Inspector
description: Agent definition with tools and output schema, a run-trace waterfall with selectable spans, token and cost stats, and a context-window meter.

title: Voice Agent Persona
description: Animated persona orb with idle, listening, thinking, speaking and asleep states, live transcript with spoken-word highlight, and mic and voice selectors.

title: Agent Workflow Canvas
description: Node-graph editor for an agent workflow: draggable nodes, bezier edges with an animated active path, zoom controls, node toolbar and inspector.
